name: Cat
dimensions: Height 64 cm; Width 28.5 cm; Height 163 cm; Width 57 cm
summary: An unique Chinese painting of a cat waiting in ambush. The painting is signed and dated by the artist to the fifth day of the New Year of jimao 已卯 year (30/1/1819). Traditionally it was believed that painting cats on this very day would ensure the protection of the household from pests

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
